Same-day pallet delivery across the Benelux

Northwind Freight collects your pallets before 11:00 and delivers them the same working day to any address in the Netherlands, Belgium or Luxembourg. Our published on-time rate for 2025 was 98.4% across 214,000 shipments.

Get a quote

How the service works

  • Collection windows are booked in 30-minute slots.
  • Every pallet is scanned at four points and tracked in real time.
  • Proof of delivery is issued as a signed PDF within 20 minutes of drop-off.
